html:
SMTO-CTR-0002 — SMTO tried to work on the task before its plan was ready

GUID: 71725f31-c82f-4182-91de-c3f939f3edbe
Slug: task-contract-accepted-contract-required
Domain: CTR · Subsystem: task-contract

What happened

  • This task uses a Task Contract, the checked plan SMTO writes before doing any work. SMTO needed that plan for the next step, but no approved plan existed, so it didn't carry out that step.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the Task contract step under the task and look at its status. It shows whether the plan is still being written, is waiting for your answer, or failed.
  2. If it says Task contract needs clarification, answer SMTO's question in the conversation. SMTO can't finish the plan until it has your answer.
  3. If it says Task contract generation failed, select Retry on the task. Retry writes the plan again so the task has an approved plan to follow.

What success looks like

  • The Task contract step shows Task contract generated and the task continues working.

If it still fails

  • If the plan already shows as generated and this still appears, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending the same request; each copy will stop at the same point.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task Contract projection was requested while task_contract_status was neither accepted nor valid, or the run state had no task_contract, so the executor input could not be rendered.

What this means

  • Contract projection is requested while task_contract_status is neither accepted nor valid, or the task_contract field is absent. This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.

Why this can happen

  • Contract projection is requested while task_contract_status is neither accepted nor valid, or the task_contract field is absent.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect accepted state and revision ownership before trying to render or execute a contract.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the run's task_contract_status, task_contract and task_contract_revision together with the Task contract activity. Complete compilation through the supported flow (answer the clarification, retry the failed attempt, or let generation finish) so an accepted revision exists before execution or result phases render it; if the status is accepted but task_contract is missing, report the inconsistent run state as a defect.
  • Resume or compile through the supported flow until an authoritative contract is accepted.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Projection uses the authoritative accepted contract for the current source.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This failure does not authorize execution for the rejected contract revision. Earlier revisions may already have effects; their original receipts remain authoritative. Diagnostic rendering makes no compiler or integrity-model call.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
